verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਗਨ ਮੈ ਲੋਗਾਚਾਰ ਬੇਦਨ ਮੈ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਸ ਇਕ ਈਸ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: logan mai logaachaar bedhan mai bedh beechaar log bedh bees ik iees gur giaan hai ||

en.bdb: A Guru-conscious seeker lives like a worldly being in the society and conducts himself as a knowledgeable person among the scholars. And yet for him, all these are worldly deeds and keeps him unsullied from them. He remains engrossed in the memory of the Lord as taught to him by the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਮੈ ਨ ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਮੈ ਨ ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗਾਤੀਤ ਉਨਮਨ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jog mai na jog bhog mai na khaan paan jog bhogaateet unaman unamaan hai ||

en.bdb: The yogic practices do not provide a seeker with the true union of the Lord. The worldly pleasures are also devoid of true comfort and peace. Thus a Guru-conscious person keeps himself free from such distractions and enjoys the true bliss by engrossing his mind in the higher spiritual state.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟ ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhirasaT dharas dhiaan sabadh surat giaan giaan dhiaan lakh prem param nidhaan hai ||

en.bdb: Guru-conscious person's vision is always focused on the glimpse of his Guru. His mind is always engrossed in repeated remembrance of Lord's name. In acquiring such divine awareness, he is able to receive the divine treasure of love of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਸ੍ਰਮ ਸਾਧਨਾਧਯਾਤਮ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਰਬੋਤਿਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੬੦॥
verses.translit_en: man bach kram sram saadhanaadhayaatam kram gurmukh sukh sarabotim nidhaan hai ||60||

en.bdb: Whatever good he does with mind, words and actions, is all spiritual. He enjoys all the happiness in the supreme treasure of Naam Simran. (60)
